test.title: A language you would like to learn in the future

document.cue: Describe a language you would like to learn in the future.

text: The language I'd really like to learn is Chinese — specifically Mandarin. I grew up speaking Kazakh and Russian, and I've been studying English for years, so it would be my fourth language, and by far the most challenging one.

The main reason is practical. China is Kazakhstan's neighbour and one of its biggest trading partners, and more and more companies here are looking for people who can communicate directly with Chinese partners. My cousin works in logistics in Almaty, and she says that colleagues who speak even basic Mandarin get noticed much faster.

My plan is to start next autumn with evening classes at a language centre, twice a week, and to combine them with an app for learning characters every day. I know that the tones will be difficult, so I'd also like to find a conversation partner online. If everything goes well, I'd love to spend a summer studying in China in two or three years' time.

Apart from my career, I think it would change how I see the world. Learning a language that's completely different from the ones I know would make me more patient and open-minded, and I'd finally be able to understand the films and food culture I've always been curious about.
It's a big commitment, but I'm quite determined to try.
